newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castor prices firm, limited new arrivals.
newsitem.headline: Indian castor prices firm, limited new arrivals.

text.p: Indian castorseed March delivery on Monday firmed at the reduced level of 1,129/1,131 rupees per quintal in a narrow trading range, traders said.
"Technically the market is oversold and fresh offerings remained restricted today," one trader said.
Groundnut oil gained to 345/346 rupees per 10 kg from 342/343 rupees on renewed demand from bulk consumers at the lower level ahead of wedding season.
Arrivals fell to 70-80 tonnes against more than 100 tonnes on Monday. In Rajkot however spot oil was steady at 525/530 rupees per 15 kg. -- Bombay Commodities +91-22-265 9000
